sentence: The competition will be held on their website this Saturday.
synonym: The contest will take place on their website
synonymNote: contest和take place意思相同，表示比赛将在网站上举行

distractors.word: The competition will be shown on their website
distractors.note: shown表示展示，不等于举办或举行

distractors.word: The competition will be sold on their website
distractors.note: sold表示出售，意思完全不同

distractors.word: The competition will be built on their website
distractors.note: built表示建造，不能替换举办的意思
